# Adding a component

A new component is one change: the component file, a server-safe
`constants.ts` when it has discrete options, the folder's `index.ts`, one line
in `src/index.ts`, and stories. It is finished when
`npm run lint` exits 0 and the hand-back below is filled in. Type-checking alone
is not "passes".

**Not for** changing an existing component (dooph-ds-writing-components) or
tokens (dooph-ds-editing-tokens).

## Procedure

1. **Spec first.** Read Figma only through a live Figma MCP; if it is expired
   or failing, STOP and tell the maintainer to reconnect it. Never guess a
   design value: list each unknown as an open question in the hand-back.
   *Prevents:* invented values.
2. **Pick the base.** Reuse DS parts (Text components, Button, Shapes, Popover)
   and Radix primitives (`import * as XPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-x"`). A
   primitive missing from package.json `dependencies` is a new dependency for
   every consumer: add it only with the maintainer's go-ahead, and report it.
   *Prevents:* hand-rolled behaviour, unapproved dependencies.
3. **Choose the folder.** A standalone component gets `src/components/<Name>/`.
   A member of an existing family goes in that family's folder and barrel
   (FancyToggleSwitch is in `Toggle/`).
   *Prevents:* two homes for one family.
4. **Write the files** from [references/file-templates.md](references/file-templates.md).
   No `.css` in the component folder: the build compiles only
   `src/styles/build.css`, which imports `index.css` (placement:
   dooph-ds-styling). *Prevents:* styles
   that never ship: emit-css compiles only `src/styles/build.css`.
5. **Export it.** The barrel names the component, its `*Props` type and its
   consts; `src/index.ts`, the only package entry, gets
   `export * from './components/<Name>';`. *Prevents:* a component no consumer
   can import, missing from `components.md`.
6. **Stories** (`*.stories.tsx`, beside the component): `Default`; every
   variant (one story each, or an `AllVariants` grid); each state, `Disabled`
   included; `Controlled` for a value control; `Practical` for an expressive
   detail. Stories use the same tokens as components, and lint scans them
   for spacing, arbitrary px/rem/em/deg and hex. A demo frame size no token
   describes goes in `style={{ width: … }}` with a short comment.
   *Prevents:* a variant or state nobody has seen render.
7. **Header contract: decide, don't default.** Write one only when the file
   carries an invariant a reasonable edit would break (CTAButton: the shape is
   fixed per size; an expressive detail always gets one, see dooph-ds-styling).
   Most files have none. Every line must be true of the code you wrote.
   *Prevents:* a false contract that later agents obey.
8. **Allowlists are decisions.** A module that truly needs `"use client"` or a
   JS timer gets an entry in `scripts/check-conventions.mjs` (use-client:
   `reason` + `needs`; timers: `reason` + `count`; the rule:
   dooph-ds-writing-components). Report it; never add one just to pass lint.
9. **CHANGELOG:** one line under `## [Unreleased]` → `### Added`. Never bump
   `version`. *Prevents:* a release that ships a component nobody announced.
10. **Verify, in order:** `node scripts/generate-docs.mjs` → `node
    scripts/sync-skills.mjs` (generate-docs rewrites the codebase-map skill's
    inventory, so the skill mirrors go stale) → `npm run lint` → every story
    in Storybook (`npm run storybook`). *Prevents:* handing back with lint red
    on stale docs or mirrors.

## Quick reference

| Need | Where | Lint check that guards it |
|---|---|---|
| Option values | `constants.ts`, const + same-named type, no directive | "variant constants named *Type"; "size keys named default or small"; "\"use client\" outside its allowlist" |
| Named exports only | `<Name>.tsx`, `index.ts` | "default exports in component modules" |
| Props documented | first JSDoc sentence → components.md | "generated doc references out of date" |
| Story text | Text components | "text-style classes outside Text components" |

## Rationalizations

| What baseline agents said | Reality |
|---|---|
| "Clean type-check." / "Type-check passes." | `tsc` is half of lint. Both runs had lint red (numeric spacing; a stale generated theme). |
| "All clean." (after `npx tsc --noEmit` only) | Lint failed on `text-style-label` and a raw `var(--ui-*)` class. |
| "Everything passes — type-check and build are clean" | A build is not lint: it failed on a hex colour and a `setInterval`. |
| Header: "`children` is reserved for the label content" | The component never read `children`. A contract must describe the code. |

**Red flags:** a report with no lint line; a value kept because it "follows the
pattern" and not reported; a header line you have not checked against the code.

## Hand-back (fill every slot; "n/a" needs a reason)

```
Lint:              npm run lint → exit 0, "conventions: N checks passed"
                   (a FAIL line only with the reason it is blocked)
Generated docs:    node scripts/generate-docs.mjs → <files it wrote>
Skill mirrors:     node scripts/sync-skills.mjs → <lines it printed> (always: the inventory changed)
Stories:           <each story name and what it shows>
Header contract:   <written: the invariant | none: why no invariant>
Design decisions:  <each value or behaviour you chose, what else it affects, open questions>
New dependency / allowlist entry: <name and reason | none>
```

# Styling inside components

Every visual value comes from a token, through a theme utility or a `ds-*` helper; every flourish on a practical component must be switchable off by `data-ds-expression="practical"`. Not for editing `tokens.css` (dooph-ds-editing-tokens) or props and API (dooph-ds-writing-components).

## Expressive details: read before any visual polish

**Test:** would a product on `data-ds-expression="practical"` expect it gone?

- **Base look:** state feedback that the spec defines, such as hover, pressed and open colours, borders, the focus ring and the disabled fade. Build it with utilities and helpers.
- **Expressive detail:** anything beyond that on a practical component (SearchBox, TextLink, a trigger, an input), such as a lean, tilt, nudge, decoration or shape. A request that says "like the caret does", "our X" or "signature" also means one.
- **Unsure:** ask the maintainer.

Expressive *components* (OutlineButton, CTAButton, shapes) are opt-in by use and are never switched.

To build an expressive detail, copy DropdownCaret's mechanism:

1. Give the detail one token, marked `/* expression */`, with a neutral value in the practical preset. dooph-ds-editing-tokens covers the steps.
2. Read the token only in a `.ds-expr-<detail>` rule in `src/styles/index.css`. Any state goes in that rule's selector.
3. The component only adds the class. It never sets the token: no inline style, arbitrary-property class, `setProperty` or prop.
4. At the neutral value, the component must still be complete, with no empty frame or gap.
5. Add a header-contract line ("must stay neutralisable by the practical preset") and a Practical story.

This applies even when the file has no header. Lint checks only tokens that are already marked, so a hard-wired utility passes it. For the full recipe and a sketch, see [references/expressive-details.md](references/expressive-details.md).

## Rules: the rule, the failure it prevents, "the lint check"

- **Colour, radius and shadow come from theme utilities** (`bg-secondary`, `rounded-tight`, `shadow-menu`). A hex or a Tailwind default ignores dark mode and overrides. "hex colour literals in components and stories", "dark-mode rules or hex colours outside tokens.css", "Tailwind default radii and shadows".
- **Spacing uses the scale words.** An off-scale value gets a token, not a bracket, because a bracket ignores token changes. "numeric Tailwind spacing", "arbitrary px/rem/em/deg in classNames". Lint knows only those units, but any bracketed look value is a missing token.
- **A token with no theme utility goes behind a `ds-*` helper**, never `[var(--ui-…)]` or `(--ui-…)`. "raw var(--ui-*) in className brackets or (--ui-*) shorthand". Where a theme utility exists, use it, always on a root that takes `className`: cn() cannot merge a helper (`cn("ds-p-ui-sm", "p-lg")` keeps both), so a consumer's class could not replace it.
- **Motion comes from the scale**, through `ds-motion-*` or `var(--ui-motion-*)` in CSS. A literal drifts from every other animation and escapes the reduced-motion collapse. Write your own reduce rule only where that collapse isn't enough: for an off-scale value (a loop, the shape-morph spring), or for motion that must become a static frame, not a shorter one (RollHover). "motion timing literals outside tokens.css", "JS timers and animation loops outside their allowlist".
- **Focus and disabled looks come from the helpers.** Hand-rolled ones drift, and they double-fade nested controls. "hand-rolled focus rings", "hand-rolled disabled looks".
- **Variants go through cva, with `className` last in `cn(…)`**, so the consumer's class wins. cn() learns class names from generated lists. After adding a `.text-style-*` or `.h-*`/`.size-*`/`.min-w-*` … rule, run `npm run sync-tokens`. Otherwise cn() misfiles the class and can erase a role as a colour. "generated theme out of date".
- **Never put a Tailwind variant on a package class** (`hover:ds-*`). It emits no rule. Put the state in the helper's selector. "Tailwind variant on a DS package class".
- **Never put `var()` in an SVG geometry attribute (`width`, `r`, `cx`…).** SVG 2 parses a presentation attribute as a value, not a declaration, so `var()` there is not specified. Chromium draws it, but its SVG DOM reads the length as 0 (`circle.r.baseVal.value`). Keep a plain number attribute and set the token through `style` or a class. `fill` and `stroke` may take `var()`. "var() in SVG geometry attributes".
- **CSS goes in `src/styles/`**, with helpers in `@layer utilities`. A `.css` under `src/components` never ships, because emit-css compiles only `src/styles/build.css`, which imports `index.css`. Text roles sit in `@layer components`, so a consumer's utility beats a role.
- **Text goes through Text components** (dooph-ds-writing-components). "text-style classes outside Text components".

## Quick reference

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Spacing (px) | `xxxs` 2, `xxs` 4, `xs` 6, `sm` 8, `rg` 10, `md` 12, `lg` 16, `xl` 20, `xxl` 26, `xxxl` 42 |
| Motion scale (`--ui-motion-*`) | `fast`, `base`, `slow`, `slower`, `slowest`; eases `standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `linear` |
| Transitions | `ds-motion-state` (colours, `rotate`, `scale`, `translate`); `ds-motion-overlay(-dialog/-sheet)` |
| Focus | `ds-focus-visible-ring`, `ds-focus-within-ring(-danger)`, `ds-focus-ring-on-focus`, `ds-focus-ring-danger-on-focus`, `ds-focus-ring-on-open`, `ds-focus-ring-sm`, `ds-shape-button-focus-visible` |
| Disabled | `ds-disabled-state`, `ds-radix-data-disabled`, `ds-opacity-disabled` (content only) |
| Tokens | [token-contract.md](../../../skills/dooph-design-system-theming/references/token-contract.md) |
| Utilities | the generated `@theme inline` block in `src/styles/index.css`: `--color-x` → `bg-x`/`text-x`, `--spacing-x` → `p-x`/`gap-x`, `--radius-x` → `rounded-x`, `--shadow-x` → `shadow-x` |

## Rationalizations

| Said in baseline | Reality |
|---|---|
| "a simple CSS rotation on hover would be more appropriate" | Simple is the bug: no preset can remove a utility. |
| "The simplest approach: add `underline decoration-wavy` Tailwind classes to TextLink." | Same bug. "Our X" exists: find it, or ask. |
| "No contract header." | The rule applies across the repo. |
| "The effect mirrors the dropdown caret's hover lean" | It copied the look, not the token or the `.ds-expr-*` rule. |

**Red flags** on a practical component:
- `hover:` or `group-hover:` combined with `rotate-`, `translate-` or `scale-`;
- `underline` or `decoration-`;
- a bracketed value.

## Verify

Run `npm run lint`. It must exit 0, and `tsc` passing on its own is not "clean". In Storybook (`npm run storybook`), check every variant and state in both themes, then check the Practical story for any trace of the detail.

# Codebase map

Everything in `dist/` is compiled from `src/`, and parts of `src/` are generated by scripts in `scripts/`. Find any source file in [references/inventory.md](references/inventory.md) (exports, header contract, `"use client"` status). Change a generated file only by running its generator.

**Not for** the rules of component code, styling or tokens, or the steps for adding a component (see the related skills).

## Where things live

| Path | Holds |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | The only public entry (`exports["."]`). Re-exports every `src/components/<Folder>/index.ts`, plus `cn`, `DS_TW_MERGE_CONFIG`, `DS_COLOR_TOKENS`, `resolveDsColor`, `DsColor`, `DsColorToken` |
| `src/components/<Folder>/` | One family: `.tsx` modules, `index.ts` barrel, stories, `constants.ts` for option consts (`IconSize` is in `Icons/BaseIcon.tsx`), internal modules (`Modal/dialogShell.tsx`, `MorphRotationShape/engine/`) |
| `src/utils/` | Public: `cn.ts`, `color.ts`. Internal: `composeRefs.ts` (`useComposedRefs`), `length.ts` (`toPxLength`). Generated: `twMergeTheme.ts` |
| `src/styles/tokens.css` | Every `--ui-*` token |
| `src/styles/build.css` | The shipped CSS entry: `index.css` with stories left out of the scan. Add nothing to it |
| `src/styles/index.css` | The Tailwind entry (Storybook's, and the build's through `build.css`): `@property` registrations, custom variants, the generated `@theme` block, `.text-style-*` roles, size utilities, animation systems and keyframes, `.ds-expr-*` helpers |
| `src/styles/dooph-component-tokens.css` | `ds-*` helpers: motion, focus, disabled, overlays, slider/progress geometry, sizing, chat prose. `ds-*` rules are in both stylesheets: grep both |
| `scripts/`, `bin/init.mjs` | Generators, lint, the `init-skills` bin: [references/build-and-scripts.md](references/build-and-scripts.md) |
| `skills/` | Consumer skills; they ship in the tarball |
| `.agents/skills/` | Maintainer skills (canonical). `.claude/skills/` and `.agent/skills/` are generated copies |

## Generated files: never hand-edit

| File | Regenerate with | Lint check |
|---|---|---|
| `@theme inline` block between the `__GENERATED_THEME_*__` markers in `index.css`; `src/styles/theme.css`; `src/utils/twMergeTheme.ts` | `npm run sync-tokens`, after editing `tokens.css` or the `.text-style-*`, `.h-*`, `.size-*`, `.min-w-*`… rules in `index.css` | "generated theme out of date" |
| `src/components/Icons/index.ts` | `npm run generate-icon-exports`, after adding or removing an `*Icon.tsx` | "icon barrel out of date" |
| `--ui-shape-morph-duration` / `--ui-shape-morph-ease` between the `__SHAPE_MORPH_EASE_*__` markers in `tokens.css` | `npm run generate-shape-morph-ease` (spring constants in `scripts/shapeMorphSpring.mjs`) | "shape-morph ease out of date" |
| `references/inventory.md`, the usage skill's `components.md`, the theming skill's `token-contract.md`, the generated block of the setup skill's `client-references.md` | `node scripts/generate-docs.mjs` | "generated doc references out of date" |
| `.claude/skills/`, `.agent/skills/` | `node scripts/sync-skills.mjs` | "skill mirrors out of sync with .agents/skills" |

## Build in one breath

`npm run build` = icon barrel, shape-morph ease, sync-tokens, tsup (which stamps `"use client"` and compiles `build.css` to `dist/styles.css`). `index.css` opens with `@import "tailwindcss" source(none)` plus `@source "../**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}"`, so Tailwind scans only `src/`, never docs or skills. Storybook compiles `index.css` (stories included); `build.css` is `index.css` plus `@source not` for stories. A utility ships only if its class name appears in a non-story file under `src/`.

## Rules

- **Never run `npm run build`, `build:watch` or `prepublishOnly` in the main checkout.** They rewrite `Icons/index.ts`, `tokens.css`, `index.css`, `theme.css` and `twMergeTheme.ts`, and run no lint. Prevents: a "verification" that churns tracked files and checks nothing. Run them in a scratch worktree; `build:js`, `build:css` and `build-storybook` write only gitignored output.
- **Never run `prep-release:*`.** It bumps the version, builds and pushes tags. Prevents: an unplanned release.
- **Edit skills in `.agents/skills/` only**, then sync. Prevents: a mirror edit the next sync overwrites.
- **After a value change, check every comment that states the old value.** Find the uses with the blast-radius greps in dooph-ds-editing-tokens, and also grep the old literal (e.g. `38px`) across `src/`. Read every comment near each use: inline, JSDoc or header contract. Flag broken arithmetic in the hand-back; never quietly reword it. Prevents: an inline sum like `// 28px items + xxs inset + 1px border = 38px` (`SegmentedTabSelect.tsx`, no header contract) going silently false.

## Common mistakes

| What the agent said | What is true |
|---|---|
| "Now add the Tailwind aliases in both theme.css and index.css." | Both are generated. Run `npm run sync-tokens`. |
| "Everything passes — type-check and build are clean." | A build is not lint, and it rewrites tracked files. Run `npm run lint`. |
| "Type-check passes." | `npm run lint` = `tsc --noEmit`, then `check-conventions.mjs`. tsc alone checks no convention. |
| "I should update the comment to reflect 40px instead of 38px" | A comment whose sum no longer balances is a design question. Flag it in the hand-back with the slack it reveals; don't reword it. |

## Verification

- REQUIRED before any hand-back: `npm run lint` exits 0.
- Edited `check-conventions.mjs`: also `node scripts/check-conventions.mjs --fixtures`.
- Changed the build or `package.json`: build in a scratch worktree, then `npm pack --dry-run`.
- Storybook: the `.claude/launch.json` "storybook" entry serves port 6007 and may already be the maintainer's, so reuse it. `npm run storybook` serves 6006.

## Summary: Understanding the CheckboxField Component Architecture

I've completed a thorough analysis of the dooph design system. Here's what you need to know:

### 1. **Existing Checkbox Component** 
Located at `/src/components/Checkbox/`:

**Files:**
- `Checkbox.tsx` - Main component wrapping Radix `CheckboxPrimitive.Root`
- `Checkbox.stories.tsx` - Stories including "WithLabel" showing basic `<label>` pattern
- `constants.ts` - Exports `CheckboxVariant` (prominent|primary) and `CheckboxChecked` (checked|unchecked|indeterminate)
- `index.ts` - Barrel exports

**Key Pattern:** Checkbox is a thin Radix wrapper with `forwardRef`, `cva` recipe, and styles via data-state attributes. No internal state — the component is purely presentational and controlled externally.

### 2. **Field/Row Patterns in the Codebase**

There is **NO dedicated CheckboxField or field-row component family** yet. However, patterns exist:

- **Input.tsx** (`/src/components/Input/`) - Shows how a "control + chrome wrapper" works:
  - `className` lands on the wrapper chrome (border, bg, rounded corner)
  - `ref` and all other props land on the inner `<input>`
  - Uses `flex items-center gap-*` for internal layout
  - For icon variants, wraps with a div and applies `gap-xxs` or `gap-sm`

- **SearchBox.tsx** (`/src/components/SearchBox/`) - Simpler pattern showing control + supporting elements:
  - `<div>` wrapper with `flex items-center gap-sm`
  - Children: icon (SearchIcon), input (via ButtonText), optional hotkey (HotkeyIndicator)
  - `className` styles the outer div; `ref`/other props go to inner input
  - Uses `ds-motion-state` and standard focus/hover states

- **Checkbox.stories.tsx** - Shows ad-hoc field pattern in "WithLabel" and "Controlled" stories:
  ```jsx
  <label className="flex items-center gap-sm">
    <Checkbox defaultChecked />
    <LabelText>Accept terms</LabelText>
  </label>
  ```

### 3. **Text Components Available**

From `/src/components/Text/index.ts`, the following Text role components exist:
- `LabelText` - for label-like content (14px, semantic)
- `BodyText` - body copy (default)
- `ButtonText` - button/input text (14px, controlled)
- `HeadingText`, `SubheadingText`, `TitleText`, `HeroText` - typography hierarchy
- `MonoText` - monospace (for code/numbers)
- `HeroBodyText`, `HeroButtonText`, `CTAText` - specialized roles

**LabelText** is the natural choice for field labels (12px, label weight, letter-spacing applied per tokens).

### 4. **File Templates for New Components**

From `.agents/skills/dooph-ds-adding-a-component/references/file-templates.md`:

**Standard structure:**
- `src/components/CheckboxField/constants.ts` - Option consts (server-safe, no "use client")
- `src/components/CheckboxField/CheckboxField.tsx` - Main component with `forwardRef`, cva recipe
- `src/components/CheckboxField/index.ts` - Barrel exports (named exports only)
- `src/components/CheckboxField/CheckboxField.stories.tsx` - Storybook stories (Default, AllVariants, Disabled, Controlled, etc.)
- `src/index.ts` - Add one line: `export * from './components/CheckboxField'`

**Stories to include:** Default, Disabled, Controlled (for state management), and optionally Practical if complex layout needed.

### 5. **Component Recipes & Guidelines**

From `.agents/skills/dooph-ds-writing-components/references/recipes.md`:

- Use **cva for variants** (class-variance-authority)
- **No "use client"** unless: state, context, browser APIs, closures, function props, or effect hooks
- **forwardRef always**, with displayName
- **Radix wrappers:** recipe first, `className` last in cn()
- **Style states via data-* attributes** only (no JS class toggling)
- **Text components render through the role** with `as` prop when root owns text
- Option consts in constants.ts (no "use client"), typed from the actual const, not cva's VariantProps

### 6. **Styling Patterns**

From `src/styles/dooph-component-tokens.css`:

Helper classes for common patterns:
- `.ds-motion-state` - transitions for color, background, border, outline, shadow, opacity, filter, transform
- `.ds-focus-visible-ring` - focus states
- `.ds-focus-within-ring` - focus-within states (for wrapper-chrome patterns like Input)
- `.ds-disabled-state` - cursor and opacity for disabled
- `.ds-radix-data-disabled` - same for Radix `data-disabled` attribute

From `src/styles/index.css`:
- `.text-style-label` - applies label typography (already defined)
- Spacing utilities: `gap-sm`, `gap-md`, `gap-lg` for flex rows
- Padding: `px-md`, `py-md`, `pl-lg`, `pr-md` etc.

### 7. **Component Export Pattern**

From `src/index.ts`: Components added via one-line exports in the `// Components` section. CheckboxField would be:
```ts
export * from './components/CheckboxField';
```

### 8. **Key Design Decisions to Make**

A CheckboxField component would likely need to handle:

1. **Props structure:**
   - Should it take `checked`, `onCheckedChange` and pass through to Checkbox?
   - Should it have optional `label`, `description`/hint text?
   - Should `className` apply to the root container or the checkbox itself?

2. **Variants:** 
   - Checkbox variant (prominent|primary) 
   - Layout: inline (checkbox + label side-by-side) vs stacked?
   - Size: standard or compact?

3. **Composition:**
   - Composition-first (CheckboxField.Checkbox, CheckboxField.Label, CheckboxField.Description)?
   - All-in-one (CheckboxField with label/description as props)?
   - Separate LabeledCheckbox component vs a field-row wrapper?

4. **Accessibility:**
   - Connect label to checkbox via `htmlFor` / `id`
   - ARIA attributes for description/hint text
   - Error state styling

This foundational knowledge should guide your CheckboxField design to align with the system's patterns around SearchBox (control + supporting elements in a flex row) and Input (wrapper chrome + inner control separation).

# Changelog

All notable changes to `@dooph-software/design-system` will be documented here.

Format: [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/)  
Versioning: [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html)

---

## [Unreleased]

The next release is a major (v6). Everything under **Breaking** stops working,
or looks different, for code written against 5.3.0. Each item says what 5.3.0
had, what v6 has, and how to fix the consumer code. Items marked **silent**
raise no compile error: find them by searching for the old name.

### Breaking

#### Components

- **`TwoWayToggle` is now `ToggleSwitch`.** Before: `TwoWayToggle`,
  `TwoWayToggleItem`, `TwoWayToggleProps`, `TwoWayToggleItemProps`. After:
  `ToggleSwitch`, `ToggleSwitchItem`, `ToggleSwitchProps`,
  `ToggleSwitchItemProps`, with the same props. Fix: rename the four names.
- **`DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` is removed.** After: `DropdownMenuMultiSelectItem`
  takes the same Radix checkbox-item props (`checked`, `onCheckedChange`,
  `onSelect`, `disabled`) and draws the DS checkbox. Fix: rename it, and set
  `selectType` on the root if the menu should stay open while the user
  ticks items:
  ```tsx
  <DropdownMenu selectType={DropdownMenuSelectType.multi}>
    …<DropdownMenuMultiSelectItem checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn}>Show grid</DropdownMenuMultiSelectItem>
  </DropdownMenu>
  ```
  For a pick-one list use `DropdownMenuRadioSelectItem` inside a
  `DropdownMenuRadioGroup`.
- **Menu width variants are removed.** Before: `DropdownMenuVariant`
  (`standard` 160px, `action` 144px, `complex` 324px) and a `variant` prop on
  `DropdownMenu` / `DropdownMenuContent`. After: items hold the 160px floor and
  the panel hugs them. Fix: drop `variant`; for a wider menu wrap the items in
  `DropdownMenuSection` and give it a width:
  `<DropdownMenuSection width="var(--ui-min-w-menu-complex)">` (324px), or any
  number of px. There is no 144px floor any more.
- **Shapes: `GemShape` is removed, and ShapeButton offers a different set.**
  Before: `GemShape`, `Shapes.gem`; `ShapeButtons` = `arrow`, `clover`,
  `cookie`, `gem`, `puff`, `star`. After: no gem shape; `ShapeButtons` =
  `clover`, `cookie`, `diamond`, `puff`, `squircle`. Fix: pick another shape
  (`DiamondShape` / `ShapeButtons.diamond` is the closest to the gem). The
  arrow and star shapes still exist as `ArrowShape` and `StarShape`; they are
  just not offered by `ShapeButton` `shape`.
- **`SegmentedTabSelect` splits variant and size, and its default changed
  (default: silent).** Before: one `variant` with seven values (`ghost`,
  `ghostSmall`, `micro`, `secondary`, `secondarySmall`, `primary`,
  `primarySmall`); with no prop it rendered `secondary` (a shell with a ghost
  active tab). After: `variant` is `primary` | `ghost`, and a new `size` is
  `container` | `standard` | `containerIcon` | `icon` (`SegmentedSize`). With
  no props it renders `primary` + `container`: a 38px shell of 28px items with
  a filled active tab. Fix:

  | 5.3.0 `variant` | v6 props |
  |---|---|
  | none (default) | `variant={SegmentedVariant.ghost}` to keep the ghost active tab (the shell is now 38px tall) |
  | `secondary`, `secondarySmall` | `variant={SegmentedVariant.ghost}` (size `container` is the default) |
  | `primary`, `primarySmall` | `variant={SegmentedVariant.primary}` or nothing |
  | `ghost` | `variant={SegmentedVariant.ghost} size={SegmentedSize.standard}` |
  | `ghostSmall` | as `ghost`, plus `size={TabSize.sm}` on each `SegmentedTabItem` |
  | `micro` | as `ghost`, plus `size={TabSize.micro}` on each `SegmentedTabItem` |

- **Value controls are named `value` / `onValueChange`.** Callback arguments
  are unchanged; each is a pure prop rename on that element:

  | Component | 5.3.0 | v6 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `VerificationCodeInput` | `onChange` | `onValueChange` |
  | `DatePicker` | `onChange` | `onValueChange` |
  | `Calendar` | `selected`, `onSelect` | `value`, `onValueChange` |
  | `DatePickerSplitTrigger` | `onSelect` | `onValueChange` |
  | `CalendarPresetItem` | `selected`, `onSelect` | `value`, `onValueChange` |

  The old names are compile errors, never silently attached DOM handlers.
- **`OutlineButton` `inverseTheme` is now `themeInverse`**, the name Tooltip
  and the AI model parts use. Fix: rename the prop.
- **`CopyButton` props are type-checked.** Before: every prop was `any`, so
  `<CopyButton />` compiled and copied the string "undefined". After: `value:
  string` is required, `variant` and `onCopied` are checked, and props it never
  supported (`size`, `asChild`, `children`, unknown attributes) are errors.
  Fix: pass `value`; drop `size`, `asChild` and `children`.
- **`CTAButton` takes `children` only with `asChild`.** Before:
  `<CTAButton text="Start" icon={…} href="/x">Start</CTAButton>` compiled and
  the children were silently dropped. After: a compile error. Fix: pass the
  label only as `text`; or use `asChild` with exactly one element child
  (`<CTAButton asChild text="Start" icon={…}><Link href="/x" /></CTAButton>`).
- **`LoadingSpinner` renders `role="progressbar"` (silent).** Before:
  `role="status"`, a live region. After: `role="progressbar"` with no
  `aria-valuenow`, like `ProgressIndicator`. Its `aria-label` default stays
  "Loading". Fix: tests that used `getByRole("status")` query
  `getByRole("progressbar")`.
- **`RollHoverText` no longer sets `aria-label` (silent).** Before: the root
  span carried `aria-label={children}`. After: the words sit in a visually
  hidden copy, so they are read in the flow of the sentence. Fix: tests that
  used `getByLabelText("Deploy now")` use `getByText("Deploy now")`.
- **`ProgressIndicator` throws on `progress={NaN}`.** Before: NaN drew a full
  ring. After: it throws the same error as a value outside 0–1. Fix: guard the
  division: `progress={total > 0 ? done / total : 0}`.

#### Props, consts and types

- **"brand" is "prominent", and "error" is "danger", in every option set.**

  | 5.3.0 | v6 |
  |---|---|
  | `ButtonVariant.brand`, `variant="brand"` | `ButtonVariant.prominent`, `variant="prominent"` |
  | `CheckboxVariant.brand` | `CheckboxVariant.prominent` |
  | `LoadingSpinnerColor.brand` | `LoadingSpinnerColor.prominent` |
  | Toast `variant` `"brand"` / `"error"` | `ToastVariant.prominent` / `ToastVariant.danger` |

- **Option consts are renamed.**

  | 5.3.0 | v6 |
  |---|---|
  | `ToastTypes` (const and type) | `ToastVariant` |
  | `TooltipTypes` (const and type) | `TooltipVariant` |
  | `FontAxes` (const) | `FontAxis` (the type already had this name) |
  | `ProgressIndicatorVariants` (const) | `ProgressIndicatorVariant` (the type already had this name) |
  | `ToggleVariant.secondary` / `"secondary"` | `ToggleVariant.ghost` / `"ghost"` |

  `ToastRoot` `variant` and `TooltipContent` `variant` (and `ToastRootProps`,
  `TooltipContentProps`) are typed by the new names.

- **The base size is called `standard` everywhere.**

  | 5.3.0 | v6 |
  |---|---|
  | `ButtonSize.default`, `size="default"` | `ButtonSize.standard`, `size="standard"` |
  | `TabSize.default` | `TabSize.standard` |
  | `ToggleSize.default` | `ToggleSize.standard` |
  | `TextDropdownSize.default` | `TextDropdownSize.standard` |
  | `AvatarSize.small`, `size="small"` | `AvatarSize.sm`, `size="sm"` |
  | `IconSize.tiny` / `.standard` / `.medium` | `IconSize.sm` / `.rg` / `.md` (new: `.lg`, 18px) |

  This is the `size` of `Button`, `TabsTrigger`, `ToggleSwitch`,
  `TextDropdownTrigger` and `Avatar`, and of icons. Fix: rename the key or the
  string literal. Search for `size="default"` and `size="small"` as well as
  the const keys.
- **Colour names passed to `color` props are renamed** (silent on `color`
  props, which also take any CSS colour string: an old name still compiles and
  paints nothing). `DS_COLOR_TOKENS`, `DsColor` and `DsColorToken` lose
  `brand`, `brand-color`, `brand-color-alt`, `error-primary`, `error-secondary`
  and `page-background`; indexing `DS_COLOR_TOKENS` with one is a compile
  error. Fix, on
  `LinearProgressIndicator`, `ProgressIndicator`, `LoadingSpinner`,
  `SliderContinuous`, `SliderStepped`, `SliderLabeled` and any `resolveDsColor`
  call:

  | 5.3.0 name | v6 name |
  |---|---|
  | `brand` | `prominent` (a different colour, see Tokens) |
  | `brand-color` | `prominent-color` (a different colour) |
  | `brand-color-alt` | `prominent-color-ter` (same #44c0e5) |
  | `error-primary` / `error-secondary` | `danger-primary` / `danger-secondary` |
  | `page-background` | `surface-page` |

  `danger` keeps its name and colour; it now reads `--ui-color-danger-primary`.
  New names: `prominent-color-alt` (a teal), plus `danger-primary`,
  `danger-secondary`, `prominent`, `prominent-color`, `prominent-color-ter` and
  `surface-page` above.
- **`null` is no longer accepted** on `Button` `variant` and `size`,
  `SheetContent` `side`, `Checkbox` `variant`, and `TabsTrigger` /
  `SegmentedTabItem` `size` and `variant` (and on the matching members of
  `ButtonProps`, `SheetContentProps`, `CheckboxProps`, `TabsTriggerProps`,
  `SegmentedTabItemProps`). `null` used to render an unstyled control. Fix:
  pass `undefined` or omit the prop: `variant={cond ? ButtonVariant.primary :
  undefined}`.
- **`Button` types `variant` × `size` as a union.** The pill sizes `medium`
  and `big` exist only on `prominent`, `primary` and `secondary`. Two forms
  that compiled in 5.3.0 stop compiling: (a) `interface X extends
  ButtonProps`; (b) a `variant` typed as the whole `ButtonVariant` union passed
  together with a `size` whose type is a union (`ButtonSize`, or even a subset
  without the pill sizes; a literal such as `size="sm"` still compiles). Fix:
  (a) `type X = ButtonProps & { … }`; (b) narrow the variant, or branch on it
  before passing a union size:
  ```tsx
  type PillVariant = Extract<ButtonVariant, "prominent" | "primary" | "secondary">;
  const isPill = (v: ButtonVariant): v is PillVariant =>
    v === "prominent" || v === "primary" || v === "secondary";
  isPill(variant)
    ? <Button variant={variant} size={size} />
    : <Button variant={variant} size={size as Exclude<ButtonSize, "medium" | "big">} />
  ```
- **`InputProps`, `SliderProps` and `SliderLabeledProps` are unions, not
  interfaces.** `interface X extends InputProps` (or `SliderProps`) no longer
  compiles. Fix: `type X = InputProps & { … }`.
- **`Input` `min` and `max` are `number`.** Before: `number | string` (the
  native attribute). Fix: `min={0}`, not `min="0"`.
- **`LinearProgressIndicator` `value` is `number` only.** Before: Radix's
  `number | null` (null drew nothing useful). Fix: pass a number, for example
  `value={v ?? 0}`.
- **`CopyButton` forwards an `HTMLButtonElement` ref** (was `HTMLElement`).
  `useRef<HTMLElement>` no longer assigns. Fix: `useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)`.
- **`IconSize` (the type) is the four token values, not `string`.** Before:
  `const s: IconSize = "2rem"` compiled. After: the `size` prop still takes any
  CSS length or number, but the type `IconSize` is only `IconSize.sm` … `.lg`.
  Fix: annotate free values as `IconProps["size"]` or `string`.
- **`DEFAULT_CALENDAR_PRESETS` and `DEFAULT_SPLIT_TRIGGER_PRESETS` are
  `readonly CalendarPreset[]`.** Assigning one to a `CalendarPreset[]`, or
  calling `.push()` on it, no longer compiles. Fix: copy first:
  `const presets = [...DEFAULT_CALENDAR_PRESETS, myPreset]`. (`DatePicker`
  `splitPresets` and `DatePickerSplitTrigger` `presets` accept readonly arrays,
  so passing the defaults back in still compiles.)
- **`ShapeProps["size"]` is `number | string`.** Passing a size is unchanged;
  code that reads it as a number (`(p: ShapeProps) => p.size * 2`) no longer
  compiles. Fix: handle the string case, or `Number(p.size)`.
- **Shape components are typed `DsShapeComponent` (a `FunctionComponent`).**
  Calling one as a plain function and typing the result `JSX.Element` no longer
  compiles (it returns `ReactNode`). Fix: render it as JSX, or type the result
  `ReactNode`.
- **Helper functions are no longer exported:** `formatTriggerLabel`,
  `formatSingleLabel`, `formatRangeLabel`, `isSameDay`, `startOfDay`,
  `serializeAxes`, `checkboxVariants`. They were internal. Fix: keep your own
  copy, for example
  ```ts
  const startOfDay = (d: Date) => new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
  const isSameDay = (a: Date, b: Date) => startOfDay(a).getTime() === startOfDay(b).getTime();
  const label = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { month: "short", day: "numeric" }).format(date);
  const serializeAxes = (axes: Record<string, number | string>) =>
    Object.entries(axes).map(([axis, v]) => `"${axis}" ${v}`).join(", ");
  ```
  For `checkboxVariants`, render `Checkbox` itself.
- **`buttonVariants()` and `tabTriggerVariants()` no longer include
  typography** (silent). Text is always set by a Text component, so the recipes carry
  only box, colour and state classes. Before: `<Link className={buttonVariants({
  variant: "primary" })}>` got the button text role. After: no text role.
  Fix: `<Button asChild variant="primary"><Link href="/x">Go</Link></Button>`
  (no change needed), or `<ButtonText as={Link} className={buttonVariants({…})}>`
  (`HeroButtonText` for the `medium` and `big` sizes).

#### Tokens

Rename overrides in your own CSS. Values that changed are noted; re-check any
look you tuned around them.

- **Colour, focus, border and radius tokens are renamed.**

  | 5.3.0 token | v6 token | value |
  |---|---|---|
  | `--ui-color-brand` | `--ui-color-prominent` | #4f666d grey-blue → #340fd9 violet |
  | `--ui-color-brand-hover` | `--ui-color-prominent-hover` | #45555b → #2406ac |
  | `--ui-color-brand-active` | `--ui-color-prominent-active` | #323d41 → #1a0189 |
  | `--ui-color-brand-foreground` | `--ui-color-prominent-foreground` | #ffffff (same) |
  | `--ui-color-brand-border` | `--ui-color-prominent-border` | alias of the fill (same rule) |
  | `--ui-color-brand-border-hover` | `--ui-color-prominent-border-hover` | alias (same rule) |
  | `--ui-color-brand-border-active` | `--ui-color-prominent-border-active` | alias (same rule) |
  | `--ui-color-brand-border-disabled` | `--ui-color-prominent-border-disabled` | transparent → the secondary disabled border |
  | `--ui-brand-color` | `--ui-prominent-color` | #46565c → #390ef8 |
  | `--ui-brand-color-alt` | `--ui-prominent-color-ter` | #44c0e5 (same). `--ui-prominent-color-alt` is a new teal, not this one |
  | `--ui-color-error-primary` | `--ui-color-danger-primary` | #ea3f3f (same) |
  | `--ui-color-error-secondary` | `--ui-color-danger-secondary` | #ff5858 (same) |
  | `--ui-color-page-background` | `--ui-color-surface-page` | same, light and dark |
  | `--ui-color-border-focus` | `--ui-color-input-border-focus` | now the prominent hover border |
  | `--ui-color-trigger-border-hover` | `--ui-color-input-border-hover` | same, light and dark |
  | `--ui-color-trigger-border-error-focus` | `--ui-color-input-border-danger-focus` | same (danger primary) |
  | `--ui-color-focus-ring-brand` | `--ui-color-focus-ring-prominent` | rgba(70,86,92,.35) → rgba(36,6,172,.35); dark .15 → rgba(52,15,217,.15) |
  | `--ui-color-focus-ring-error` | `--ui-color-focus-ring-danger` | rgba(236,85,85,.35) → rgba(234,63,63,.35); dark .15 likewise |
  | `--ui-shadow-focus-brand` | `--ui-shadow-focus-prominent` | 4px ring in the prominent colour |
  | `--ui-radius-standard` | `--ui-radius-normal` | 18px (same) |
  | `--ui-icon-tiny`, `--ui-icon-standard`, `--ui-icon-medium` | `--ui-icon-sm`, `--ui-icon-rg`, `--ui-icon-md` | 12 / 14 / 16px (same) |
  | `--ui-icon-large` | `--ui-icon-lg` | 20px → **18px** |
  | `--ui-icon-stroke` | `--ui-icon-stroke-width` | 2 (same) |
  | `--ui-height-tab-micro` | `--ui-height-button-micro` | 30px → 28px (micro tabs are 2px shorter) |
  | `--ui-size-cta-icon` | `--ui-size-cta-icon-standard` / `--ui-size-cta-icon-big` | 20px → 22px / 26px |

  Fix, as one pass over CSS and TS (longest names first, so `brand-color-alt`
  is not caught by `brand-color`):
  ```js
  const TOKENS = {
    "--ui-color-brand-border-disabled": "--ui-color-prominent-border-disabled",
    "--ui-color-brand-border-active": "--ui-color-prominent-border-active",
    "--ui-color-brand-border-hover": "--ui-color-prominent-border-hover",
    "--ui-color-brand-foreground": "--ui-color-prominent-foreground",
    "--ui-color-brand-border": "--ui-color-prominent-border",
    "--ui-color-brand-active": "--ui-color-prominent-active",
    "--ui-color-brand-hover": "--ui-color-prominent-hover",
    "--ui-color-brand": "--ui-color-prominent",
    "--ui-brand-color-alt": "--ui-prominent-color-ter",
    "--ui-brand-color": "--ui-prominent-color",
    "--ui-color-error-primary": "--ui-color-danger-primary",
    "--ui-color-error-secondary": "--ui-color-danger-secondary",
    "--ui-color-page-background": "--ui-color-surface-page",
    "--ui-color-border-focus": "--ui-color-input-border-focus",
    "--ui-color-trigger-border-hover": "--ui-color-input-border-hover",
    "--ui-color-trigger-border-error-focus": "--ui-color-input-border-danger-focus",
    "--ui-color-focus-ring-brand": "--ui-color-focus-ring-prominent",
    "--ui-color-focus-ring-error": "--ui-color-focus-ring-danger",
    "--ui-shadow-focus-brand": "--ui-shadow-focus-prominent",
    "--ui-radius-standard": "--ui-radius-normal",
    "--ui-icon-tiny": "--ui-icon-sm", "--ui-icon-standard": "--ui-icon-rg",
    "--ui-icon-medium": "--ui-icon-md", "--ui-icon-large": "--ui-icon-lg",
    "--ui-icon-stroke": "--ui-icon-stroke-width",
    "--ui-height-tab-micro": "--ui-height-button-micro",
    "--ui-size-cta-icon": "--ui-size-cta-icon-standard",
  };
  const names = Object.keys(TOKENS).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
  const re = new RegExp(`(?<![\\w-])(${names.join("|")})(?![\\w-])`, "g");
  source = source.replace(re, (name) => TOKENS[name]);
  ```
- **The spacing scale is renamed to match Figma, with a new 6px step.** The
  same names now mean smaller sizes, so every `--ui-spacing-*` override and
  every spacing utility (`p-md`, `gap-lg`, `max-w-md`, …) shifts down a step.

  | 5.3.0 | px | v6 name for that size |
  |---|---|---|
  | `xxs` | 4 | `xxs` (same) |
  | — | — | new `xs` = 6px, new `xxxs` = 2px |
  | `xs` | 8 | `sm` |
  | `sm` | 10 | `rg` |
  | `rg` | 12 | `md` |
  | `md` | 16 | `lg` |
  | `lg` | 20 | `xl` |
  | `xl` | 28 | `xxl` (now 26px) |
  | `xxl` | 40 | `xxxl` (now 42px) |

  Fix: apply the map in ONE pass. Applied step by step it chains (`xs`→`sm`,
  then that `sm`→`rg`). For example:
  ```js
  const STEP = { xs: "sm", sm: "rg", rg: "md", md: "lg", lg: "xl", xl: "xxl", xxl: "xxxl" };
  const UTIL = "p|px|py|pt|pr|pb|pl|ps|pe|m|mx|my|mt|mr|mb|ml|ms|me|gap|gap-x|gap-y|space-x|space-y|inset|inset-x|inset-y|top|right|bottom|left|start|end|w|h|size|min-w|min-h|max-w|max-h|inline|min-inline|max-inline|basis|scroll-m|scroll-p|translate-x|translate-y";
  const re = new RegExp(`(--ui-spacing-|(?<![\\w-])-?(?:${UTIL})-)(xxl|xl|lg|md|rg|sm|xs)(?![\\w-])`, "g");
  source = source.replace(re, (_, prefix, step) => prefix + STEP[step]);
  ```
  Run it BEFORE the `ds-*-ui-*` helper table below: that table already gives
  v6 names, which this map would shift a second time. The regex leaves
  `text-*` alone and does not touch the `ds-*-ui-*` names.
- **17 per-component motion tokens are removed.** Motion now runs on one
  shared scale (see Added). Overriding a scale token retunes every component
  on that step; to change one component alone, target its `ds-*` class.

  | removed | use |
  |---|---|
  | `--ui-reveal-change-in-duration` | `--ui-motion-duration-slower` |
  | `--ui-reveal-change-out-duration` | `--ui-motion-duration-slow` |
  | `--ui-reveal-change-ease` | `--ui-motion-ease-enter` |

  | `--ui-roll-change-out-duration` | `--ui-motion-duration-base` |
  | `--ui-roll-change-in-ease` | `--ui-motion-ease-enter` |
  | `--ui-roll-change-out-ease` | `--ui-motion-ease-exit` |
  | `--ui-roll-hover-duration` | `--ui-motion-duration-slower` |
  | `--ui-rolling-digits-duration` | `--ui-motion-duration-base` |
  | `--ui-rolling-digits-enter-duration` | `--ui-motion-duration-slow` |

  | 5.3.0 utility | v6 utility |

  | `bg-brand`, `bg-brand-hover`, `bg-brand-active`, `text-brand`, `border-brand` | `bg-prominent`, `bg-prominent-hover`, `bg-prominent-active`, `text-prominent`, `border-prominent` |

  | `*-error-primary`, `*-error-secondary` | `*-danger-primary`, `*-danger-secondary` |
  | `*-page-background` | `*-surface-page` |
  | `*-border-focus` | `*-input-border-focus` |
  | `*-trigger-border-hover` | `*-input-border-hover` |
  | `*-trigger-border-error-focus` | `*-input-border-danger-focus` |
  | `rounded-standard` (and `rounded-l-standard` …) | `rounded-normal` |
  | `shadow-focus-brand`, `shadow-focus-error` | `shadow-focus-prominent`, `shadow-focus-danger` |
  | `h-tab-micro` | `h-button-micro` |

  `*` is any colour utility prefix (`bg-`, `text-`, `border-`, `ring-`,
  `outline-`, `fill-`, `stroke-`, …), with or without variants, and the
  matching `--color-*` / `--radius-*` / `--shadow-*` theme variables. Fix, in one
  pass:
  ```js
  const KEYS = {
    "brand-border-disabled": "prominent-border-disabled", "brand-border-active": "prominent-border-active",
    "brand-border-hover": "prominent-border-hover", "brand-border": "prominent-border",
    "brand-color-alt": "prominent-color-ter", "brand-color": "prominent-color",
    "brand-hover": "prominent-hover", "brand-active": "prominent-active", "brand-fg": "prominent-fg",
    "brand": "prominent", "error-primary": "danger-primary", "error-secondary": "danger-secondary",
    "page-background": "surface-page", "trigger-border-error-focus": "input-border-danger-focus",
    "trigger-border-hover": "input-border-hover", "border-focus": "input-border-focus",
    "focus-brand": "focus-prominent", "focus-error": "focus-danger", "standard": "normal", "tab-micro": "button-micro",
  };
  const PREFIX = "--color|--radius|--shadow|bg|text|border(?:-[trblxyse])?|ring|ring-offset|outline|fill|stroke|divide|placeholder|caret|accent|decoration|from|via|to|shadow|rounded(?:-[trblse]{1,2})?|h";
  const keys = Object.keys(KEYS).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length).join("|");
  const re = new RegExp(`(?<![\\w-])(-?(?:${PREFIX})-)(${keys})(?![\\w-])`, "g");
  source = source.replace(re, (whole, prefix, key) =>
    (key === "standard" && !prefix.startsWith("rounded")) || (key === "tab-micro" && prefix !== "h-") ||
    ((key === "focus-brand" || key === "focus-error") && prefix !== "shadow-") ? whole : prefix + KEYS[key]);
  ```

  `ds-progress-ring*`, `ds-shape-morph*`, `ds-slider-*`, `ds-spinner-*`,
  `ds-width-chat-model-tooltip`.
- **`DS_TW_MERGE_CONFIG`**: the package's tailwind-merge config, for an app
  with its own merge helper:
  `extendTailwindMerge<"text-style">(DS_TW_MERGE_CONFIG)`.
- **`init-skills --yes`** (or `-y`) answers every prompt yes.
- **The `dooph-design-system-setup` skill** ships with the package (install,
  imports, fonts, the Tailwind preset, Server Components).

### Changed

- **Motion runs on one shared scale.** Every duration and curve comes from the
  `--ui-motion-*` tokens; retune all motion by overriding them. Overlays
  (menu, tooltip, popover, toast, modal, sheet) use the enter curve when they
  open and the exit curve when they close. Some timings moved to the nearest
  step: hover transitions 100 → 150ms, menu and tooltip open 100 → 150ms,
  CopyButton swap 120/160 → 150ms, Slider glide 180 → 200ms, reveal-change out
  320 → 300ms, rolling digits 240/260 → 200/300ms, SidebarWithHoverIcon
  260/180 → 300/200ms, RollHoverText 500 → 420ms. Hover transitions also ease
  opacity, shadow and transform, and no longer ease layout properties.
- **Reduced motion is one global rule:** every scale duration collapses to
  1ms and the staggers to 0. Loops stop or show a still frame: the flat
  spinner freezes at its longest arc, spokes and star stop turning.
- **`LoadingSpinner`** animates in CSS, with no JavaScript loop. The flat
  variant runs Material's circular indeterminate motion and paints on the
  first, server-rendered frame. It relies on CSS `@property`.
- **The prominent colour is violet** (#340fd9 in place of the 5.3.0 grey-blue
  brand colour), with its hover, active and focus-ring shades.
- **Dark theme:** `--ui-color-text-tertiary` is #8b8b8b (was #717171), so
  dark placeholders and meta text read better.
- **Change text:** `RollChangeText` travels a shorter distance
  (`--ui-roll-change-depth` 0.9em → 0.55em), its blur scales with the font
  (`--ui-roll-change-blur` 4px → 0.1em; a px override still works), and its
  edge fades out instead of being cut off.
- **`CTAButton`**: the round end chip is a fixed shape per size (an
  eight-leaf clover at standard, a puff at big), in the secondary or primary
  button colour; the icon slot is 22 / 26px; the label is a semibold
  `CTAText`; the big pill has 16px padding and hugs its content.
- **`PopoverContent`** (and the DatePicker panel) use the floating-panel look
  of the menus: the popover border, the modal surface (dark #212124 in place
  of #000000) and the menu shadow, and sit 6px from the trigger (was 4px).
- **`CTAButton`**'s ref is typed `HTMLElement` (was `HTMLAnchorElement`),
  because with `asChild` the root can be any element. A
  `RefObject<HTMLAnchorElement>` or an anchor-typed callback ref still
  compiles; narrow before reading anchor-only fields such as `href`.
- **`SearchBox`** draws the DS `SearchIcon` (16px, stroke 2) in place of its
  own thinner glyph.
- **CopyButton**'s icon swap zooms: the outgoing icon shrinks and fades as the
  incoming one grows in.
- **The dropdown triggers** (`DropdownTrigger`, `TypeableDropdownTrigger`)
  use `DropdownCaret` in place of the plain chevron; their right padding is
  0. A disabled `DropdownTrigger` fades as one piece, chevron included.
- **Icons:** `IconProps` is a type alias (an intersection) rather than an
  interface; `interface X extends IconProps` still compiles. `color` sets CSS
  `color`, so parts filled with `currentColor` follow it (`strokeColor` still
  wins for the stroke). An icon with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is no
  longer `aria-hidden`.
- **Colour props** on `ProgressIndicator`, `LoadingSpinner`,
  `ShapeMorphSpinner`, `AIContextGauge` and `LinearProgressIndicator` take
  any `DS_COLOR_TOKENS` name (`"text-secondary"`, `"danger"`, …) as well as a
  CSS colour. Before, names other than `primary` / `brand` drew nothing.
- **`"use client"` only where a module needs it.** Button, Checkbox,
  ShapeButton, CodeDigitInput, Modal, Popover, Sheet, Tooltip, Tabs, SearchBox,
  SplitButton, LinearProgressIndicator, DatePickerTrigger, LoadingSpinner and
  RollChangeText render as server components (their Radix parts stay client),
  and `buttonVariants` / `tabTriggerVariants` can be called from server code.
- **Text is always set by a Text component.** Every component renders its text
  through `ButtonText`, `BodyText`, `LabelText` and the other roles (with
  `as`), so typography sits on one element. Rendered output is unchanged
  except: the transparent CodeDigitInput glyph uses the body family, and the
  Calendar preset buttons lost a redundant inner span.
- **Styling hooks:** `CalendarGrid` documents `data-range`, `data-today` and
  `data-outside` on its day cells, and `HotkeyIndicator` sets `data-pressed`,
  for consumer selectors such as `data-[range=middle]:…`.
- **`ShapeMorphSpinner`, `DropdownCaret` and `MorphRotationShape`** pass
  `Shapes` keys, so they render from a React Server Component.
- **`styles.css` holds only what the components use.** Utility classes that
  appeared only in this repository's docs, skills or Storybook stories are no
  longer compiled into it, and its theme layer drops six `--color-*` variables
  only stories read (`--color-primary`,
  `--color-text`, `--color-text-secondary`, `--color-text-tertiary`,
  `--color-prominent-color`, `--color-prominent-color-alt`). The set of
  generated utilities in the sheet follows the component markup, so it changes
  whenever a component's classes do; it is not a contract. If your markup used
  a generic utility (`w-64`, `p-4`, `text-white` …) without running your own
  Tailwind, add it to your own build; read `--ui-*` tokens instead of the
  `--color-*` variables.
- **Smaller tarball:** about half the files (no unreachable per-module files
  or CommonJS source maps), and the ESM source maps of stamped chunks line up
  with their code.
- **The consumer skills** (`dooph-design-system-usage`,
  `dooph-design-system-theming`) are rewritten for v6; the v3 and v5 migration
  skills were corrected against their own releases.

  the text colour).
- `ToastProvider` `duration` sets the auto-dismiss delay of every toast it
  renders; a per-toast 4000ms used to override it. The default stays 4000ms,
  and a per-toast `duration` still wins.
- Toasts closed by their timer, the close button, Escape or a swipe play their
  exit animation; they used to vanish at once. `dismiss()` no longer waits on
  a 200ms timer.
- `ToastDescription` inside a prominent `ToastRoot` uses the prominent
  foreground colour, so hand-composed prominent toasts are legible; `ToastRoot`
  renders `data-variant`.
- `ToastClose` keeps the toast's text colour on hover and press (it was near
  invisible on the prominent toast).
- `Calendar` no longer crashes on an invalid `value` or an unknown `mode`: it
  warns in development and renders nothing. The DatePicker triggers show an
  empty label for an invalid value instead of throwing.
- `asChild` on `OutlineButton`, `ShapeButton`, `DropdownTrigger` and
  `TextDropdownTrigger` no longer throws "Slot failed to slot onto its
  children"; the child element becomes the interactive root and the
  decoration renders inside it.
- `OutlineButton` runs a consumer's `onMouseMove` / `onMouseLeave` alongside
  its glow tracking instead of losing the tracking.
- `cn` keeps every `text-style-*` role beside a colour class (`text-body`
  next to a text colour no longer erases the colour).
- The flat `ProgressIndicator` no longer paints a stray track dot near
  completion, no longer flashes when it animates back to 0, and its track no
  longer jumps back or disappears when `progress` changes quickly.
- `ProgressIndicator` has a default accessible name, "Progress"; your
  `aria-label` replaces it and `aria-labelledby` drops it.
- `SplitButtonTrigger` has a default accessible name, "More options". The
  split parts share the secondary `Button`'s border, hover and press borders,
  and disabled / `aria-disabled` paint.
- `DatePickerSplitTrigger` merges `triggerProps.className` after its seam
  classes instead of replacing them, and `disabled` on `DatePickerSplitTrigger`
  or `SplitButton` can no longer be undone by a part's `disabled: false`.
- `Input`: `hasError` sets `aria-invalid` on the `<input>`; a disabled plain
  input no longer lifts on hover.
- `VerificationCodeInput`: focusing an empty cell past the first empty one
  moves focus to the first empty cell, so a typed digit lands where it shows.
- `Slider`: `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` land on the
  `role="slider"` thumb, which no longer falls back to the name "Value" when
  labelled by reference; PageUp / PageDown and Shift+Arrow move 10 steps on
  stepped sliders; extra values in a multi-value array are kept, not dropped
  or moved.

  roles, and sortable headers set `aria-sort`; sortable header labels use the

  focus ring is 2px.

- Disabled `CalendarPresetItem`, `SearchBox` and `CodeDigitInput` render the
  DS disabled state; an `aria-disabled` SplitButton part or `ShapeButton` no
  longer reacts to hover and press.
- `TypeableDropdownTrigger` no longer puts Radix's `type="button"` on its root
  `<div>`.
- A consumer `style` now wins over a component's own inline values in
  `LinearProgressIndicator` and `Slider` (the new `DropdownMenuSection`,
  custom `Sticker` and AI model parts behave the same way).
- A consumer padding class now replaces the padding of `SearchBox`,
  `DropdownTrigger`, `TypeableDropdownTrigger`, `Input`, `DropdownMenuContent`,
  `DropdownMenuSection`, `DropdownMenuSearch`, `OutlineButton` and
  `OutlineSection`, and a gap class replaces the dropdown triggers' gap,
  instead of competing on stylesheet order.
- Sizes and spacing of Button, SplitButton, SearchBox, HotkeyIndicator,
  DropdownTrigger, Tooltip, Toast, Table, Tabs, Avatar, ShapeButton,
  CodeDigitInput, the menu label, TextDropdownTrigger, Checkbox, OutlineSection
  and LinearProgressIndicator follow `--ui-*` overrides.
- `HeartFillIcon` fills the 24-unit icon grid (it rendered at about 58% size in
  the top-left corner).
- `ArrowShape`, `CloverShape` and `CookieShape` no longer emit a clipPath with a
  fixed `id`, so two on one page no longer duplicate ids.
- Nested `.dark` regions work: inside a `.dark` element on a light page, every
  alias token (danger button, tooltips, selection, shimmers, focus and press
  rings, slider steps, the secondary sticker…) takes its dark value. A
  consumer `:root` override of the checkbox size or radius, or the avatar
  radii, now reaches dark regions too.
- `Input` no longer detaches and re-attaches a callback `ref` on every
  keystroke.
- `RollHoverText` is read as part of the sentence by screen readers.
- Server components: every client module in `dist` carries `"use client"`,
  including those whose file opens with a header comment. In 5.3.0
  `VerificationCodeInput`, `DropdownMenuSearch`, `SidebarWithHoverIcon`,
  `RevealChangeText`, `RollChangeText` and `RollingDigitsText` shipped without
  it, so a React Server Component could not render them.
- `init-skills` with no terminal (piped or closed stdin) installs into all
  three directories instead of exiting 0 having copied nothing.
- The package ships `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, with the shape-morph MIT notice

## [1.1.0] — 2026-06-23

### Added
- **React Server Component (RSC) support is now built in.** Every interactive
  component ships a per-module `"use client"` directive that is preserved into
  `dist`, so a Next.js App Router **Server Component** can
  `import { Button } from "@dooph-software/design-system"` (and context-driven
  components like `Tooltip`/`DropdownMenu`) and `next build` succeeds with no
  `createContext is not a function` error. **Consumers no longer need a local
  `"use client"` re-export wrapper barrel.**

### Changed
- Build now emits one chunk per source module (tsup `splitting`, multi-entry)
  instead of a single inlined barrel, so client and server-safe modules stay
  separate and directives survive per module. `dist/index.js` remains the single
  public entry. Pure/server-safe modules (`cn`, type-only files, variant enums,
  icon/shape SVG components, `BaseText`) intentionally carry **no** directive and
  stay renderable in the RSC layer. ESM + CJS outputs, the exports map,
  `sideEffects`, types, and `styles.css`/`theme.css` emission are unchanged.
- Dot-accessible variant/size enums (`ButtonVariant`, `ButtonSize`, `TabVariant`,
  `TabSize`, `ToggleVariant`, `ToggleSize`, `SegmentedVariant`, `TextDropdownSize`,
  `ShapeButtons`, `CheckboxChecked`, `CheckboxVariant`, `ToastTypes`, `TooltipTypes`)
  moved out of their (now client) component files into sibling server-safe
  `constants.ts` modules, so a Server Component can read enum **values**
  (e.g. `ButtonVariant.primary`) without crossing a client boundary. Public import
  paths via the package barrel are unchanged; only internal deep imports were
  rewired.
